mechanism: Foscarnet causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that may impair apixaban clearance and increase bleeding risk; apixaban is renally eliminated and sensitive to renal function changes.
action: Monitor renal function closely, maintain adequate hydration during foscarnet therapy, and consider alternative anticoagulation if significant renal impairment develops; assess bleeding signs regularly.
